title: Scalar-extension tensor and unit constraints descend and are coherent
statement:
Let $C$ be a site small in a fixed ring and module universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $A,S$ be sheaves of commutative rings, and let $\alpha:A\to S$ be a unital ring-sheaf map. For an $A$-module sheaf $H$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $T(H)=(U\mapsto S(U)\otimes_{A(U)}H(U))^\#$ be scalar extension using module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], with maps induced by $1\otimes h$, and let $q_H(h)$ denote the sheafification image of $1\otimes h$. All tensors are sheafified balanced tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with the canonical associators and unitors [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. For each $H,K$ there is a unique $S$-linear sheaf map $D_{H,K}:T(H\otimes_AK)\to T(H)\otimes_ST(K)$ satisfying
$$D_{H,K}(q_{H\otimes_AK}(h\otimes k))=q_H(h)\otimes q_K(k)$$
on every object of $C$. These maps form a natural family. The scalar formula $D_0:T(A)\to S$, given on local generators by $s\otimes a\mapsto s\alpha(a)$, is a well-defined sheaf isomorphism with inverse $s\mapsto s\otimes1$. Each $D_{H,K}$ is a sheaf isomorphism with formulas
$$D_{H,K}(s\otimes(h\otimes k))=(s\otimes h)\otimes(1\otimes k),\quad D_{H,K}^{-1}((s\otimes h)\otimes(t\otimes k))=st\otimes(h\otimes k).$$
The family $(D,D_0)$ satisfies all three oplax constraint equations, written with $\circ$ applied from right to left:
$$ (1\otimes D_{K,H'})D_{H,K\otimes H'}T(a_{H,K,H'})=a_{TH,TK,TH'}(D_{H,K}\otimes1)D_{H\otimes K,H'}, $$
$$\lambda_{TH}(D_0\otimes1)D_{A,H}=T(\lambda_H),\qquad \rho_{TH}(1\otimes D_0)D_{H,A}=T(\rho_H).$$
Here $H,K,H'$ are arbitrary $A$-module sheaves. The inverse tensor and unit maps satisfy the corresponding lax constraint equations. The assertions include compatibility with restrictions and descent through module sheafification; no flatness, nonzero-ring or enough-points hypothesis is imposed.
